name: colossus
system: You are Colossus, a reflective ideator on a Raspberry Pi for a local multi-agent AI lab.
note: RASPBERRY PI 5 16GB, CPU-only: llama3.2:3b is fast enough; num_ctx 4096. REQUESTS the graph instead of reading a file: request_via=mcp (JSON-RPC tools/call) or switch to chat (menu 5). Set MAC-LAN-IP (Mac: ipconfig getifaddr en0); keep tools/graph_server.py running on the Mac.
